description: List Codemate's published articles, newest first, with date, category, summary and URL. Filter by category or by date. Use this when asked what Codemate has written or published about something, or for recent news — search_site only returns the closest few matches.

category.description: Category filter, matching the site's own article filter tabs.

lang.description: Which language edition of the site to answer from. Defaults to English.

since.description: Only articles published on or after this date. A year ("2026") or an ISO date.

name: list_articles
